title: A widget on the desktop
tags: The joys of a Mac app

options.label: Yes, after the menu bar
options.act: WidgetKit: per-project state + top card with an App Intent button
options.then: Build a desktop widget after the menu bar: agent states, and the top card with a Go-with-it button.

why: A desktop widget (WidgetKit; interactive since macOS Sonoma) shows each project's agent state and count, plus the top card with a Go with it button that answers it in place through an App Intent. You see it every time a window moves aside. Things and Reminders have interactive widgets like it.
Recommended after the menu bar, not before: the menu bar is always visible, and a widget is only visible when the desktop is.
